This page inventories the article and textbook material currently rendered from the AffineDrift repository. Labels such as _canonical_, _reference_, and _exploratory_ describe editorial status on the site; they do not imply peer-review status.

::: {.callout-note}
## How to Use This Catalog

Start with [Overview](../pages/overview.html) if you want the site's scope and evidence standards.

Use [The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html) and [The Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html) as the two main textbook entry points.

Treat the tangent-space series as the canonical rendered reading path. The older Tangent Hyperplane Contraction workspace and draft packages now redirect into that seven-part path rather than rendering as parallel article sets.
:::

## Textbooks

### Core Textbook Entries

- [The Physics of Golf](../articles/The_Physics_of_Golf/quarto/index.html): golf-specific textbook treatment of mechanics, control, and biomechanical modeling.
- [The Geometry of Motion](../articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/quarto/index.html): broader mathematical series covering rigid-body dynamics, control, biomechanics, neural control, and simulation.
- [Proximal-to-Distal Energy Transfer (Technical Monograph)](../articles/proximal_distal_energy_transfer/index.html): full 34-chapter mathematical monograph on distal handoff timing, multi-station Coulomb friction, interface power ledgers, and Latin Hypercube parameter sweeps.

### Book Series Volumes

- [All Books and Textbooks](../books/index.html): navigation page for core textbooks and working book-series volumes.
- [Volume I: Tangent-Space Methods for Nonlinear Control](../books/tangent-space-methods.html): foundations of tangent-space exactness, contraction, local optimal control, and counterfactual decomposition.
- [Volume II: Control Is Motion](../books/control-is-motion.html): trajectory-centric nonlinear control and geometric mechanics framing for high-dimensional motion.
- [Volume III: Biomechanics - Biology to Systems](../books/biomechanics-biology-to-systems.html): biomechanical modeling, experimental pipelines, and inference workflows.
- [Volume IV: Human Motor Control](../books/human-motor-control.html): neural architecture, dimensionality reduction, internal models, and movement intelligence.

## Canonical AffineDrift Series

- [Drifter Manifesto overview](../pages/drifter-manifesto.html): primary AffineDrift series on the control-affine description of the golf swing.
- [Drifter Manifesto (Single-File Edition)](../articles/drifter-manifesto.html): comprehensive single-file edition of the foundational control-affine golf swing manifesto.
- [Theory Part 1](../articles/theory-part1.html): state definition, modeling assumptions, and derivation of the control-affine form.
- [Theory Part 2](../articles/theory-part2.html): drift/input separation and the zero-torque and zero-velocity counterfactual constructions.
- [Theory Part 3](../articles/theory-part3.html): taxonomy, invariants, and scope conditions for the framework.
- [Theory Part 4](../articles/theory-part4.html): derivations, wrench-based views, and supporting pendulum examples.
- [Theory Part 5](../articles/theory-part5.html): implementation notes and Simulink-oriented technical documentation.

## Tangent-Space and Contraction Work

- [Tangent-Space Series landing page](../pages/tangent-hyperplanes.html): editorial overview, provenance note, and reading order for the tangent-space material.
- [Compact Part I: Geometry](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-1-geometry.html): short orientation page on tangent-space geometry and finite-step residuals.
- [Compact Part II: Dynamics](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-2-dynamics.html): short orientation page on variational dynamics along a reference trajectory.
- [Compact Part III: Control](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-3-control.html): short orientation page on LQR, iLQR, and DDP as local methods.
- [Compact Part IV: Residuals and Curvature](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-4-residuals-curvature.html): short orientation page on residual scaling and limits of linearized predictions.
- [Compact Part V: Contraction](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-5-contraction.html): contraction certificates as tangent-space stability statements.
- [Compact Part VI: Hybrid Systems](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-6-hybrid.html): saltation maps, mode changes, and the limits of smooth tangent reasoning.
- [Compact Part VII: Residual-Aware Control](../articles/tangent-hyperplanes-series/part-7-residual-aware.html): residuals as trust-region, controller-switching, and validation signals.
- [Full Reference Manuscript: Exact Instantaneous Superposition in Nonlinear Dynamics](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Tangent_Hyperplanes_Unified_Thesis.html): single-file reference manuscript retained for derivations, appendices, and historical traceability.
- [Contraction Theory Meets Tangent Spaces](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Contraction_Tangent_Unification.html): source article behind compact Part V, with longer derivations and implementation sketches.
- [Contraction Tangent Unification (Layman's Guide)](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Contraction_Tangent_LAYMAN.html): plain-language overview of contraction in tangent spaces.
- [Hybrid Tangent Spaces](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Hybrid_Tangent_Spaces.html): source article behind compact Part VI, with saltation and contact-implicit detail.
- [Hybrid Tangent Spaces (Layman's Guide)](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Hybrid_Tangent_LAYMAN.html): introductory summary of hybrid systems and mode switching.
- [Residual-Aware Control](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Residual-Aware_Control.html): source article behind compact Part VII, with algorithm sketches and applications.
- [Residual-Aware Control (Layman's Guide)](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/Advanced/Residual-Aware_Control_LAYMAN.html): plain-language explanation of residual monitoring.
- [Lay summary and critique pages](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/TABLE_OF_CONTENTS.html): companion pages for the exploratory series, including summaries and objections.
- [Layman's Terms Summary](../articles/tangent-hyperplane-articles/LAYMANS_TERMS_SUMMARY.html): comprehensive layman's guide across all tangent-space topics.

## Biomechanical and Energy Transfer Studies

- **[Proximal-to-Distal Energy Transfer in the Golf Swing](../articles/proximal-distal-energy-transfer.html)**: counterfactual dynamics analysis of distal handoff timing, segment work budgets, and parametric energy transfer.
- **[How a Golf Swing Carries Energy](../articles/proximal-distal-a-journey-through-the-swing.html)**: a visual, book-like route through the same mechanics, with plain-language explanations, model boundaries, and direct paths into the open evidence.
- [Why an Optimized Double Pendulum Stops Its Hands](../articles/impact-optimality-and-model-limits.html): an exact impact-optimality result showing that a point-mass-clubhead model's speed-optimal swing stops the hands, and the structural limit that exposes.
- [Explore the Proximal–Distal Models (Workbench)](../articles/proximal-distal-model-workbench.html): interactive model exploration workbench for proximal-to-distal dynamics.
- [Multibody Dynamics: Drift, Control, and the Geometry of Physical Law](../articles/calculation-framework-comparison/multibody-drift-control-v3.html): comparative article linking several dynamics formalisms to the same drift/control split.
- [Intentional Constraint Collapse at Impact](../articles/intentional-constraint-collapse.html): exploratory note on impact-time constraint structure.
- [Interpretation of Inverse Dynamics](../articles/inverse-dynamics.html): limits of inverse-dynamics inference and force-attribution claims.
- [Constraint Torques at the Wrist](../articles/wrist-universal-joint.html): wrist/grip torque transmission with an interactive visualization.
- [Superposition in Affine Control Systems](../articles/superposition.html): superposition with respect to inputs in control-affine mechanics.
- [Controllability and Drift-Control Ratio](../articles/controllability-drift-ratio.html): controllability analysis framed around drift/control balance.
- [Natural vs Active Forces and Torques in Affine Mechanical Systems](../articles/drift-components-wrench-double-pendulum.html): passive versus applied contributions in a double-pendulum example.
- [On the Limits of Strokes-Gained Inference for Individual Golfers](../articles/strokes-gained-limitations.html): constraints on what strokes-gained style statistics can support.
- [Secondary Axis Stability in Golf Clubs](../articles/secondary-axis-stability.html): mechanical note on rotational stability and club behavior.
- [Degrees of Freedom and the Curse of Dimensionality](../articles/degrees-of-freedom-and-dimensionality.html): coordination complexity in high-dimensional movement systems.
- [Ideomotor Theory and the Predictive Brain Model](../articles/ideomotor-theory-and-predictive-brain.html): conceptual article linking motor-control theory and prediction-based views of action.
- [Passive Distributed Control: Frans Bosch Framework](../articles/passive-distributed-control.html): commentary on Bosch's framework in relation to passive dynamics.
- [Zero-Torque Counterfactual](../articles/zero-torque-counterfactual.html): short note on the zero-torque counterfactual construction used throughout the site.

## Technology, Measurement & Simulation

- [Impact Mechanics and Ball Flight: A Reference Treatment](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html): comprehensive reference treatment of rigid-body collision, gear effect, ball flight laws, and closure rate.
- [Club Fitting Simulation and Parameter Identification](../articles/technology-club-fitting.html): forward multibody dynamics, spatial screw theory, and watertight mesh inertia identification for deterministic club fitting.
- [Multibody Impact Coupling and the Heavy Hit Hypothesis](../articles/technology-heavy-hit-impact-coupling.html): contact time scales, elastic wave transit, and the tau-squared decoupling law refuting the heavy hit.
- [Force Measurement Technology: Plates, Pressure, and the Ground Reaction Wrench](../articles/technology-force-measurement.html): force plates, pressure mapping, and ground reaction wrench measurement.
- [Launch Monitor Technology: Measurement and Inference](../articles/technology-launch-monitors.html): optical, radar, and hybrid tracking systems, state reconstruction, and uncertainty.
- [Markerless Mocap Camera Selection](../articles/markerless-mocap-camera-selection.html): source-bounded industrial camera candidates, selection calculations, licensing boundaries, and a fail-closed two-camera shop pilot.
- [Motion Capture Technology: Reconstruction, Artefact, and the Rotation Problem](../articles/technology-motion-capture.html): optical marker sets, skin movement artefact, and 3D rotational kinematics.
- [Launch Monitor Vendor Reference](../articles/launch-monitor-vendor-reference.html): comparative reference of commercial launch monitor hardware, coordinate systems, and specifications.
- [Simulating the Green: Surface Mechanics and Trajectory Modeling](../articles/green-simulation.html): ball-turf contact dynamics, grain modeling, and rolling mechanics.
- [The Physics of the Rolling Putt](../articles/putting-roll-models.html): true-roll transitions, skid phases, and surface friction models.
- [The Reference-Point Problem in Club Delivery Data](../articles/reference-point-problem.html): coordinate frame alignment and measurement ambiguity in club delivery metrics.
- [Rotation-Induced Spin: Gear Effect Without an Off-Centre Strike](../articles/rotation-induced-spin.html): mathematical derivation of closing-rotation spin generation through the contact patch.

## Reference and Companion Articles

- [Affine Control Interpretation of the Golf Swing](../articles/affine-nature-golf-swing.html): alternate long-form manuscript covering the same central framework from a different editorial path.
- [Applications of the Control-Affine Framework in Golf Swing Biomechanics](../articles/appendix-applications.html): application-focused companion article.
- [Inverse Dynamics Inference](../articles/inverse-dynamics-inference.html): extended note on inference limits in inverse-dynamics settings.
- [Nonlinear Control Theory Insights](../articles/nonlinear-control-insights.html): conceptual companion note on causal interpretation and open questions.
- [Force and Mobility Ellipsoids in the Golf Swing](../articles/force-mobility-matrices.html): Jacobian-based force/mobility interpretation.
- [The Null Space of the Constraint Jacobian](../articles/null-space-constraint-jacobian.html): constrained versus unconstrained motion in multibody systems.
- [Classic Sources of Nonlinearity in Mechanical Systems](../articles/sources-of-nonlinearity.html): catalog of nonlinear effects relevant to modeling assumptions.
- [Lagrangian Reference for Control-Affine Multibody Dynamics](../articles/lagrangian-reference.html): energy-based derivation of the drift/input split.
- [Screw Theory Reference for Control-Affine Multibody Dynamics](../articles/screw-theory-reference.html): coordinate-free reference treatment using twists and wrenches.
